issue.title: Session panel fold-levels PNG test times out on the agent-xprompt anchor since sase-18g.2 detached xprompts into identity headers
issue.description:
Deterministic, not a flake: the test fails in its initial capture and both serial recovery attempts (sase-17m.5.1.4 visual run 9145426c3c614970a237fdbe8d04e83f), and again identically on a clean base tree during sase-17m.5.1.5.

Root cause: sase-18g.2 commit 4af219eba ("feat(ace): detach agent xprompts into identity headers") made the session-panel renderer emit the `AGENT XPROMPT` section only when the xprompt does NOT detach into the identity header (`src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/prompt_panel/_agent_display_agent_session_render.py`, `if not xprompt_detached: append_section_heading(header_text, "AGENT XPROMPT")`). In the test fixture the xprompt detaches, so the Main deck never has an `agent-xprompt` section anchor, and `scroll_main_section_to_top(page, "agent-xprompt")` times out after 15s. Later assertions `resolved_main_section(page) == "agent-xprompt"` are stale for the same reason.

Impact: blocks pixel proof and re-baselining of goldens `agents_session_conversation_level_1_120x40`, `agents_session_conversation_level_2_120x40`, and `agents_session_panel_level_2_120x40`, and leaves every full `just fix-tui-screenshots` run `partial`.

Fix direction: retarget the scroll/assert steps at the first conversation section that still exists for a detached-xprompt session (for example `agent-prompt`), or render the fixture non-detached if the conversation-at-xprompt capture is still wanted; then re-baseline the three goldens through a targeted `just fix-tui-screenshots` run and inspect each diff. Also check whether `_FOLD_INERT_AGENT_SECTION_IDS` in `src/sase/ace/tui/actions/navigation/_fold.py` still needs `agent-xprompt`.

Proposed by sase-17m.5.1.4 note #1 and sase-17m.5.1.5 note #1; routed by the sase-17m.5.1 land agent. Not caused by epic sase-17m.5.1 (the renamed test file carries the same failure the pre-rename `test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_family_panel.py` had after 4af219eba).
